hero.description: Perseus is a self-hosted Git collaboration platform with real-time collaborative editing, pull requests, issue tracking, and built-in chat — all under your control.

features.title: A complete Git platform
features.subtitle: From repository hosting to real-time collaborative editing, Perseus packs everything your team needs into one self-hosted solution.

codeHosting.title: Code Hosting
codeHosting.desc: Full Git repository management with fork, star, and granular access control across four roles: Owner, Admin, Developer, and Readonly.

pullRequests.title: Pull Requests & Review
pullRequests.desc: Draft PRs, inline code reviews, labels, conflict detection, and activity timelines — everything for a smooth review workflow.

issueTracking.title: Issue Tracking
issueTracking.desc: Create, close, and reopen issues with priorities, labels, batch operations, and threaded comments for organized project management.

realtimeCollab.title: Real-time Collaboration
realtimeCollab.desc: Google Docs-style collaborative editing powered by Yjs CRDT. Live cursors, presence indicators, and conflict-free merging.

codeSearch.title: Code Search
codeSearch.desc: Blazing-fast code search across all repositories using Git object indexing and PostgreSQL pg_trgm GIN for substring matching.

webhooks.title: Webhooks & CI
webhooks.desc: 18 event types with HMAC-SHA256 signing, delivery history, automatic retries, and build status tracking for CI integration.

releaseManagement.title: Release Management
releaseManagement.desc: Tag-based releases with file attachments, draft and pre-release support, and structured release notes for every version.

adminMonitoring.title: Admin & Monitoring
adminMonitoring.desc: Full admin console with system monitoring, configuration management, Redis administration, and real-time log streaming.

collab.title: Edit together, in real time.
collab.description: Perseus brings Google Docs-style collaboration to your codebase. Multiple developers can edit the same file simultaneously with live cursors, presence indicators, and zero merge conflicts.

liveCursors.title: Live Cursors & Presence
liveCursors.desc: See exactly where your teammates are editing and who is online in each file.

crdtEngine.title: Yjs CRDT Engine
crdtEngine.desc: Powered by battle-tested Yjs CRDT algorithm for conflict-free concurrent editing at any scale.

chat.title: Built-in Chat & Comments
chat.desc: Repository chat channels, direct messages, and inline file comments — all WebSocket real-time.

collab.chatMessage: LGTM! Let me add the token refresh logic.

desktop.title: A native desktop experience.
desktop.description: Perseus Desktop, built with Wails, delivers the full power of the platform as a native application. Go beyond the browser with system-level integration, offline capabilities, and a distraction-free development environment.

wails.title: Powered by Wails + Go
wails.desc: Lightweight Go backend with a native WebView frontend. Fast startup, minimal memory, no Electron bloat.

offline.title: Offline Development
offline.desc: Work locally with full Git operations, then sync when you are back online. Your code is always accessible.

terminal.title: Built-in Terminal & LSP
terminal.desc: Integrated terminal, Language Server Protocol support, and a full code editor right in the desktop app.

architecture.title: Your data. Your servers.
architecture.subtitle: Deploy Perseus on your own infrastructure with Docker. Full control over your code, your data, and your pipeline.
architecture.dockerNote: All services deployed via Docker Compose

privacy.title: Complete Data Privacy
privacy.desc: Your source code never leaves your infrastructure. No third-party has access to your repositories, issues, or discussions.

control.title: Full Control & Customization
control.desc: Configure every aspect of your instance — from authentication providers to storage backends. Extend with webhooks and APIs.

deploy.title: One-Command Docker Deploy
deploy.desc: Get up and running with a single docker compose up. All services pre-configured and ready to go.

security.title: Enterprise-Grade Security
security.desc: OAuth integration (GitHub/GitLab), SSH key management, HMAC-signed webhooks, and audit logging for full compliance.

admin.title: Monitor and manage everything.
admin.subtitle: A comprehensive admin console gives you full visibility into your instance — from system health to Redis management to real-time logs.

cta.title: Deploy your own instance today.
cta.description: Get Perseus up and running in minutes with Docker. Your team will be collaborating in real time before you know it.

footer.tagline: A self-hosted Git collaboration platform with real-time editing, built for teams who value control and speed.

cleanup.title: Cleanup old logs
cleanup.desc: Delete log directories and files older than the retention period. Defaults to keeping the last 30 days (1–365).

operations.title: Maintenance
operations.subtitle: App-level shutdown and restart; dangerous actions require a confirmation word

restart.title: Restart service
restart.desc: Trigger a graceful shutdown and relaunch the process using the current run mode. Under debug mode Uvicorn takes over; in production the startup command is re-executed. In-flight requests may be interrupted.

shutdown.title: Shutdown service
shutdown.desc: Broadcast the shutdown notice, disconnect all WebSocket connections, release the database pool, then terminate the process. Service must be started manually afterwards.

debug.title: Debug Tools
debug.subtitle: Destructive debug endpoints, available only to admins in debug mode
debug.gateDesc: Debug tools require both is_admin and app.debug. The service is not running in debug mode (app.debug=false), so they cannot be accessed.

initdb.title: Reset database
initdb.desc: Drop and recreate every table, then bootstrap the admin account on startup. All repository metadata, users, issues and PRs will be permanently lost.

initconf.title: Reset config file
initconf.desc: Delete the current config.toml and regenerate it from config.example.toml. The original is backed up with a timestamp.

redis.title: Redis Operations
redis.subtitle: From GET /api/app/redis/status (admin-only, read-only) · worker liveness & subscription health come from the Redis heartbeat registry; metrics from INFO.

notConfigured.title: Redis not configured
notConfigured.desc: PERSEUS_REDIS_URL / REDIS_URL is empty. Request stats, presence, OAuth state and cross-worker broadcast fall back to in-process — features keep working but lose cross-worker/replica consistency.

unreachable.title: Redis unreachable (degraded)
unreachable.desc: Connection probe failed (1s timeout, 5s retry cooldown). Strong dependencies degrade explicitly; caches fall back to DB/disk.

workers.title: Workers & subscriptions
workers.hint: From heartbeat registry · each worker should hold 1 broadcast subscription
workers.empty: Registry empty (Redis disabled or no heartbeat yet)

config.title: Config (read-only)
config.hint: Injected via env/compose; no write endpoint
